name: Acme billing bot (example)
app_description: Customer support bot for a SaaS billing product (Acme Cloud). Answers questions about invoices, refunds, plan changes and payment methods. It must never promise refunds outside policy. Replies under 120 words, in the user's language.
constraints: Never reveal internal policy IDs (they look like POL-1234). Always reply in the user's language. Refund promises only per policy: offer to check eligibility, never guarantee.
known_failure_notes: The current prompt is too verbose and sometimes over-promises refunds.
